mutants.label: [control] closed_below compares the name with the literal 'late' instead of BANDS[-1]
mutants.why: BANDS is tuple(ELEVATION_BANDS) and its last key is 'late' (geometry.ELEVATION_BANDS order golden, early, mid, late), so BANDS[-1] == 'late' and the boolean is identical for every band name on every path. Inert over the whole suite; it would differ only if ELEVATION_BANDS were reordered, which no test or caller does.
mutants.find: closed_below = name == BANDS[-1]
